intro: Illiyana Moonblaze is an unconventional night elf scout and quartermaster stationed at Silverwing Grove in Ashenvale. Operating alongside the Silverwing Sentinels, she supplies Alliance champions waging war against the Warsong Outriders. Despite her formal officer standing, her sharp instincts and roguish demeanor set her apart from traditional kaldorei military ranks.

p: Illiyana Moonblaze serves as the primary supply officer for the Silverwing Sentinels nestled in Silverwing Grove. Yet, one look reveals she is far from an ordinary sentinel. Wielding twin blades and donning dark corsetry, she carries the swagger of a rogue or a buccaneer rather than the disciplined poise of Elune's faithful warriors. Traditional sentinel hierarchy has historically viewed those of her trade with wariness, likening them almost to lawless rogues. Nevertheless, her unmatched cunning and talent for tracking make her invaluable in the contested woodlands.

Beyond her unconventional scouting duties, Illiyana equips Alliance volunteers preparing to clash with the Warsong clan in Warsong Gulch. As champions earn favor with the Silverwing Sentinels, she rewards their service with custom rations, specialized draugths, and masterwork armaments designed specifically for woodland skirmishes. She also maintains weapons and armor for weary fighters returning from the frontline, keeping the Sentinels' war effort supplied and functional.
